title: Yummy Comforting Peruvian Chicken Arroz Con Pato
description: A classic Peruvian dish that combines the flavors of barbecue sauce, caramelize onions, and tender chicken. This comforting meal is a great option for weeknights and holidays alike.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast to the skillet and cook until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the onion to the skillet and cook until caramelized, about 8 minutes.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the barbecue sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the rice to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 18 minutes.
Add the chicken back to the skillet and stir to combine.
Serve hot, garnished with ginger if desired.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
